   │ AND labels = alpha
   │ AND labels = beta
   │ AND labels = gamma
   │ AND labels = delta
   │ AND labels = epsilon
   │ AND labels = zeta
   │ AND labels = eta
   │ AND labels = theta
   │ ORDER BY created DESC
 limit: 1
